chunks: And with this chain of narration, he said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said:
When you cook, use plenty of gourd, for it gladdens [strengthens -Khall] the sorrowful heart.
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual or physical benefit of eating gourd according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida*, this hadith highlights the Prophet’s practical wisdom in using dietary means to nurture spiritual well-being, specifically noting that gourd (qar') soothes the melancholic heart. This reflects the Shia tradition of integrating physical health with emotional and spiritual resilience, viewing food as a means to strengthen the heart against sorrow.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 31-86 According to the same documentation, God’s Prophet (S) said, “
When you cook use a lot of gourd since it alleviates sorrows.”
